insight: Created by Prefect CEO Jeremiah Lowin, who built the first version over a single weekend.
name: FastMCP
tagline: The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
description: An open-source Python framework for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients. You declare a tool as a Python function and FastMCP generates the schema, validation, and protocol plumbing, and handles transport, auth, and the connection lifecycle for you. FastMCP 1.0 was folded into the official MCP Python SDK; v2 is the actively developed standalone superset. The framework is free and Apache-2.0; Prefect's Horizon platform adds managed hosting and enterprise governance.
edge: v2 is the standalone superset most Python MCP servers build on; v1 was folded into the official MCP Python SDK.
pros: Decorate a function, get an MCP tool
cons: Managed hosting is a separate paid product
